blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Hyper-Connections (HC) expand the residual stream of a Transformer into $N$ parallel streams, and manifold-constrained HC (mHC) stabilizes them at scale. However, mHC benefits little from more than four streams, partly because each sublayer writes a single output to all streams, limiting how differently they can be updated. In this work, we propose TPHC, which integrates tensor-parallel (TP) shards with HC streams to promote greater independence across streams. Specifically, we route a separate mixture of the residual streams to each TP shard and keep the individual shard outputs separate during write-back, so each stream can receive a different mixture of those outputs. This design makes the residual-stream updates more expressive without adding parameters or FLOPs to the attention or FFN sublayers. With native support for stream sharding under TP, TPHC requires only 9% more training time than mHC on an 8B model when both use four streams. Increasing the number of streams from four to sixteen raises its training time by only 19%. On a 1.1B model trained on 100B tokens, TPHC reduces validation loss by 0.7-1.0% and raises average zero-shot accuracy across six commonsense reasoning benchmarks by 0.3-0.7 percentage points relative to mHC at matched stream counts $N\in\{4,8,16\}$. Our code is available at https://github.com/wuyou2002/TPHC.
blocks.zh: Hyper-Connections(HC)将变形器的剩余流扩展为一元并列流,多节制的HC(mHC)使其规模稳定. 然而,mHC从超过4个流中得益甚微,部分原因是每个子层会为所有流写出一个单一的输出,限制了这些流的更新方式的不同. 在这项工作中,我们提出TPHC,它将拉诺-平行(TP)硬体与HC流相融合,以促进各流之间更大的独立性. 具体地说,我们把残余流的单独混合物输送到每个TP硬化后,在回写时保持单个硬化输出的分离,这样每个流就可以得到这些输出的不同混合物. 这种设计使得残流更新更能表现,而不给注意或FFN子层添加参数或FLOP. blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Hyper-Connections ( Zhu et al., 2025a , HC;) have recently attracted growing interest as an effective approach to improving the performance of large language models (LLMs).
HC expands standard residual connections ( He et al., 2016a ; He et al., 2016b ) from a single residual path to N N parallel residual streams, introducing learnable control over inter-layer information flow.
Specifically, each sublayer reads a learned mixture of the streams and writes its output back to them, while a learned N × N N{\times}N matrix mixes the residual streams.
Building on HC, Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections ( Xie et al., 2026 , mHC;) constrain this residual mixing matrix to be doubly stochastic to
stabilize signal propagation across layers.
The DeepSeek-V4 series adopts mHC ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026b ) , and
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash uses a Single-Pass variant designed to enable
more efficient kernel fusion ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026a ) .

blocks.en:
Most HC-family models use N = 4 N{=}4 , since additional streams bring little gain while substantially increasing computational cost.
xHC ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) attributes these limited gains to the shared source of stream updates: each stream receives a scaled copy of the same sublayer output.
Therefore, it proposes temporal feature augmentation (TFA) to address this problem, which derives additional write-back components from causal convolutions of the FFN outputs from nearby preceding tokens.
blocks.zh:
大多数HC-家庭模型使用N=4NQQ4,因为额外的溪流带来的收益很少,同时大大提高了计算成本.
xHC (Zhang et al., 2026)将这些有限的收益归结为流更新的共享源:每条流都收到一个缩放的子层输出副本.
因此,它提出时间特征增强(TFA),以解决这一问题,这个问题从附近的前兆对FFN产出的因果演化中获得了额外的回写组件.

blocks.en:
In this work, we explore the possibility of using the partial outputs of tensor-parallel shards as a complementary source of write-back diversity.
Large models commonly use tensor parallelism ( Shoeybi et al., 2019 , TP;) for training and inference.
Consider the computation graph of mHC with TP sharding.
TP splits each attention and FFN sublayer across k k devices by heads or hidden units, so that each shard computes a partial output from a shared input.
An all-reduce aggregates these partial outputs into a single output, which mHC then writes to all streams.
Thus, the k k partial outputs already computed by TP are collapsed into the single write-back component.
Instead, we propose TPHC ( T ensor- P arallel grouped H yper- C onnections), which treats the shards as groups and preserves their outputs as separate write-back components (Figure 1 ).
In this way, each sublayer contributes k k separate write-back components rather than one.
In addition, each group reads its own learned mixture of the N N streams, allowing group-specific inputs as well as outputs.
Unlike xHC, our grouped write-back applies to both attention and FFN sublayers by adapting the existing HC read and write
mappings to the TP groups, without introducing additional
feature-augmentation modules.
TPHC increases the training time of mHC by only 7–8% on 1.1B and 8B models when both use four streams.

大型模型通常使用拉伸平行论(Shoeybi等人,2019年,TP;)用于培训和推论.

blocks.en:
This grouped design also naturally supports tensor parallelism.
Each group resides on a separate device, naturally partitioning the group inputs and outputs across devices.
The residual streams can also be sharded accordingly, with both read and write operations implemented using reduce-scatter collectives.
This reduces the memory cost of the residual streams and makes training models with larger stream counts feasible: at the 8B scale, increasing N N from 4 4 to 16 16 raises the training time of TPHC by only 19%, compared with 59% without sharding.

这种分组设计也自然支持拉伸平行主义.
每个组都居住在一个单独的装置上,自然地将组的投入和产出分成不同的装置。
残余的流也可以相应被冲压,同时使用减散体集合执行读写操作.
这降低了剩余溪流的内存成本,使具有较大溪流计数的培训模式成为可行:在8B尺度上,NN从4 4增加到16 16,使得TPHC的训练时间只增加了19%,而59%没有磨损.

blocks.en:
In order to further reduce the cost of the mappings, we adopt the sparse update of xHC ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) with a fixed schedule, so each layer writes only k k of the N N streams while every sublayer still reads all of them.
This reduces the cost of generating the mappings from O ⁡ ( N 3 ​ C ) O(N^{3}C) to O ⁡ ( k ​ N 2 ​ C + k 3 ​ C ) O(kN^{2}C+k^{3}C) .
In addition, we initialize each group to read from and write to its own stream.
This group-specific initialization breaks the symmetry ( Alimaskina et al., 2026 ) within each sublayer
and we empirically find it benefical to model performance.
blocks.zh:
为了进一步降低测绘成本,我们采用了xHC(Zhang等人,2026年)的零星更新,并有固定的时间表,因此每层只写Kkk的N流,而每个子层仍然读全部.
这降低了从O ⁡(N 3 C) O(N ^{3}C)到O ⁡(k N 2 C + k 3 C) O(kN^{2}C+k^{3}C)的绘图生成成本.
此外,我们将每个组初始化,从自己的溪流读写.
这种针对群体的初始化打破了每个子层内的对称性(Alimaskina等人,2026年).
我们从经验上发现 模拟性能是件好事

blocks.en:
Our experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of TPHC.
On a 1.1B model, TPHC achieves lower training and validation loss than mHC with N N from 4 4 to 16 16 .
It also improves average zero-shot accuracy on commonsense reasoning tasks by up to 0.7 percentage points over mHC.
Notably, TPHC with 8 streams outperforms mHC with 16 streams.
Our analysis also suggests that the shared write drives the mHC streams toward a common direction, whereas the TPHC streams remain less homogeneous.
blocks.zh:
我们的实验证明了TPHC的有效性.
在1.1B模型上,TPHC的培训和验证损失比NN从4 4到16 16的mHC要低。
这也提高了常识推理任务的平均零射精度,比mHC提高了0.7个百分点.
值得注意的是,拥有8条溪流的TPHC超过16条溪流的mHC.
我们的分析还表明,共同写作促使mHC流向共同方向发展,而TPHC流则不那么一致。

blocks.en: xHC ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) shares our motivation of making better use of multiple residual streams. Its sparse residual-stream architecture mixes and writes only k k of the N N streams, a few fixed ones and others chosen per token by a learned router, while every sublayer still reads all N N . It also adds write-back components to each FFN through TFA. Our TPHC retains the dense read and the sparse update of xHC but selects the written streams with a fixed schedule and obtains the additional write-back components from the TP partition of each sublayer.
blocks.zh: xHC(Zhang等人,2026年)分享了我们更好地利用多条残流的动机. 它的稀疏的残余流结构混合,只写了N N流的k k,少数固定流和被一个学习过的路由器每个符选择的其他流,而每个子层仍然读取所有N N . 它还通过TFA为每个FFN添加回写组件. 我们的TPHC保留了xHC的密集读取和稀疏的更新,但选择有固定时间表的写流,并从每个子层的TP分区中获取额外的回写组件.

blocks.en:
Alimaskina et al. (2026) trace the under-use of HC streams to their permutation symmetry at initialization and break it with Learned Stream Scaling (LSS), learnable per-stream scales applied where the residual is expanded into streams. In TPHC, we break this symmetry within each sublayer by
initializing each group to read primarily from and write primarily to a distinct stream.
blocks.zh:
Alimaskina等人(2026年)在初始化时将HC流的利用不足情况追溯到它们的对称性,并用 " 学习流放大 " (LSS)打破它,在剩余部分扩展成流时,采用可学习的每流尺度。 在TPHC中,我们打破了每个子层的对称性
初始化每个组,主要读取并主要写给不同的流.

blocks.en:
mHC-lite ( Yang and Gao, 2026 ) builds exactly doubly stochastic matrices without Sinkhorn iterations, and Frac-Connections ( Zhu et al., 2025b ) split the hidden state into fractions instead of copying it.
Other work improves cross-layer information flow by aggregating
earlier activations instead of expanding the residual state ( Huang et al., 2017 ; Pagliardini et al., 2024 ; Xiao et al., 2025 ; Kimi Team, 2026 ) .

blocks.en: 2.2 Tensor Parallelism
blocks.zh: 2.2 日照平行主义

blocks.en:
Megatron-style TP splits each attention sublayer by heads and each FFN by its intermediate dimension across t t devices ( Shoeybi et al., 2019 ; Narayanan et al., 2021 ) .
The first projection is column-parallel : each device computes the queries, keys and values of its heads, or its slice of the FFN units, from the replicated input.
The output projection is row-parallel : each device produces a partial output in ℝ C \mathbb{R}^{C} , and one all-reduce per sublayer sums them.
Sequence parallelism ( Korthikanti et al., 2023 ) rewrites each all-reduce as a reduce-scatter and an all-gather.
These collectives are a major cost, especially in latency-bound inference ( Pope et al., 2023 ) .
Ladder-Residual ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) reroutes residual connections so that communication overlaps with computation, and SPD ( Kim et al., 2025 ) drops synchronization points after selected attention sublayers.
TPHC likewise modifies the architecture around the TP collectives, but instead of rescheduling the all-reduce, it removes the summation of the shard outputs.

blocks.en:
Compared with mHC, TPHC changes how each sublayer reads from and writes to the N N streams.
Its central component is the grouped hyper-connection, which keeps the outputs of the TP groups separate (§ 3.1 ).
It is complemented by the sparse update (§ 3.2 ) and an initialization that places each group on its own stream (§ 3.3 ).
We describe the TP implementation, in which both groups and streams are sharded across devices (§ 3.4 ).
Algorithm 1 in Appendix D gives the full procedure for one sublayer.

补充的还有零星更新(第3.2节)和初始化,将每个群体放在自己的溪流上(第3.3节)。
我们描述的是TP的执行,在这种执行中,组合和流在各种装置之间被磨碎(第3.4节)。

blocks.en:
At initialization, the input-dependent component of each mapping
is zero, so the mapping is determined solely by its static bias.
In mHC, the token embedding is copied to all streams, and each
sublayer writes its single output to every stream with the same
weight, so the streams remain identical and the model starts as
a standard Transformer. If TPHC used the same initialization, it would write the sum of the group outputs to
every stream, so all groups would read the same input and start
as shards of a single standard sublayer.

blocks.en:
We evaluate TPHC on the Llama ( Touvron et al., 2023 ) model, comparing language modeling loss and zero-shot commonsense reasoning accuracy across different stream counts (§ 4.1 ).
We test the prefill and training cost on a single GPU and under tensor parallelism (§ 4.2 ).
We conduct ablation studies to examine the contributions of grouped reads and writes, initialization, and the sparse updates (§ 4.3 ). Finally, we analyze the similarity of residual streams and their write-back mixtures across depth to examine how TPHC affects stream diversity (§ 4.4 ).

blocks.en: 4.2 Efficiency
blocks.zh: 4.2 效率

blocks.en:
We test the prefill and training cost of the TinyLlama-1.1B and Llama-3.1-8B models ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) under two configurations: single-GPU execution without TP and four-GPU execution with a TP degree of 4.
Table 2 reports the results.
Without TP at both scales, TPHC4 introduces 4–7% additional prefill latency compared with mHC4, and 7–8% additional training step time.
Under TP with sharded streams at the 8B scale, TPHC4 is 6% slower than mHC4 in prefill and 9% slower in training, while using 5% more peak training memory. Compared with replicated streams, sharding reduces the prefill latency of TPHC4 by 15% at 1.1B and 14% at 8B, versus 10% and 4% for mHC4. It also reduces the peak training memory of TPHC4 by 47% and 36%, respectively.

如果没有两种比例的TP,TPHC4则引入了4-7%的额外预填休息时间,而mHC4则引入了7-8%的额外培训步骤时间。
TP下有8B尺度的硬化流,TPHC4在预填时比mHC4慢6%,在训练时慢9%,同时使用5%的峰值训练内存. 与复制流相比,加固使TPHC4在1.1B时的预填空隙减少15%,在8B时减少14%,而mHC4则减少10%和4%. 它还将TPHC4的峰值训练内存分别减少47%和36%.

blocks.en:
At 1.1B, however, sharding increases the training step time of TPHC4 from 185.8 to 193.3 ms. Its training overhead relative to mHC4 is 19% with replicated streams and 27% with sharded streams.
A possible reason is that the additional collectives add a roughly fixed cost, which outweighs the savings when the per-GPU workload is small.
Sharding also slightly increases the prefill memory of mHC4 from 0.91 to 0.94 GiB. Apart from these two exceptions, sharding reduces both latency and peak memory.
blocks.zh:
然而,在1.1B时,加固使TPHC4的训练步数从185.8米增加到193.3米。 与mHC4相比,其培训间接费用为19%,可复制溪流,27%为碎溪流。
一个可能的原因是,增加的集体成本大约是固定的,这超过了每个GPU工作量小时的节省。
硬化还使mHC4的预填内存从0.91略微增加至0.94 GiB. 除了这两个例外外,硬化还减少了耐久性和峰值内存.

blocks.en:
The benefits of sharding grow with N N .
At the 8B scale, sharding reduces the prefill latency of TPHC8 and TPHC16 by 27% and 30%, their training step time by 21% and 28%, and their peak training memory by 56% and 62%, respectively.
Scaling from TPHC4 to TPHC16 with sharded streams increases prefill latency by 12%, training step time by 19%, and peak training memory by 26%. The corresponding increases with replicated streams are 39%, 59%, and 114%. On a single GPU, TPHC16 runs out of memory during training.

从TPHC4到TPHC16的加固流将预填空档增加12%,培训步骤时间增加19%,峰值培训内存增加26%. 相继增加的是39%、59%和114%。 在单一的GPU上,TPHC16在训练期间耗尽了内存.

blocks.en: 4.4 Stream Diversity Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.4 流式多样性分析

blocks.en:
To examine how the models use their streams, we measure the mean pairwise cosine similarity between streams after each sublayer on SlimPajama validation data (Figure 5 a).
In mHC4, the streams become increasingly aligned with depth, reaching a cosine similarity of 0.985 at the last layer, while their norms remain comparable.
The multi-stream residual thus collapses toward a single direction, even though all streams remain in use.
blocks.zh:
为了检查模型如何使用它们的流,我们在SlimPajama验证数据(图5a)上测量每个子层之后各流之间的平均对偶余弦相似性.
在mHC4中,溪流越来越与深度一致,在最后一层达到0.985的余弦相似度,而其规范仍然可比较.
因此,尽管所有溪流仍在使用中,但多流残留物向单一方向崩溃。

blocks.en:
A likely cause is mHC’s shared write-back. ℋ l res \mathcal{H}^{\mathrm{res}}_{l} remains close to the identity in most layers, and the stream norms grow by more than an order of magnitude with depth, so each stream is dominated by its accumulated writes.
In mHC, these writes are scalar multiples of the same sublayer outputs, so all streams are weighted sums of the same vectors and differ only in their weights.
blocks.zh:
MHC共享回信, Hl res\ mathcal{H}^{\ mathrm{res}}_{l}在大多数层中仍然接近身份,溪流规范随着深度增长超过一个数量级,因此每条溪流都以其累积的写作为主.
在mHC中,这些写法是同一个子层输出的scalar倍数,因此所有流都是同一个矢量的加权总和,并且只在重量上有所不同.

blocks.en:
mHC-TFA4 and TPHC4 both write multiple distinct outputs, the four TFA components of the FFN output and the group outputs, respectively.
Both reduce the stream similarity relative to mHC4, and TPHC4 attains the lowest similarity throughout the second half of the network, ending at 0.917 compared with 0.966 for mHC-TFA4.
The two differ in the similarity of the write mixtures that different streams receive (Figure 5 b).
In mHC-TFA4, the attention sublayers still write a single output, since TFA augments only the FFN, and even in the FFN sublayers the streams receive similar mixtures (0.79 on average).
In TPHC4, whose groups are initialized to write to their own streams, the mixtures remain distinct (0.40 on average) and become similar only in the last layers, where the streams also align.
blocks.zh:
mHC-TFA4和TPHC4都分别写出多种不同的输出,FFN输出的四个TFA组件和组输出.
两者都相对mHC4降低了流的相似性,TPHC4在网络的下半部达到最低的相似性,以0.917结束,而mHC-TFA4则为0.966.
两者在不同的流得到的书写混合物的相似性上有所不同(图5b).
在mHC-TFA4中,注意力子层仍然写着单一的输出,因为TFA只增强FFN,即使在FFN子层中,流也得到相似的混合物(平均0.79).
在TPHC4中,其组群初始化后会写给自己的流体,这些混合物仍然不同(平均为0.40),仅在流体也对齐的最后一层才变得相似.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We propose TPHC, which improves HC by using tensor-parallel sublayer partitions to produce distinct write-back components without increasing the parameters or FLOPs of the attention and FFN sublayers.
TPHC achieves lower training and validation loss than mHC and mHC-TFA for N ∈ { 4 , 8 , 16 } N\in\{4,8,16\} , raises the average zero-shot commonsense reasoning accuracy of mHC, and with 8 streams outperforms mHC with 16.
We also implement TP with sharded streams for TPHC, keeping the training-time overhead of TPHC4 relative to mHC4 small at the 8B scale and makes TPHC16 affordable.
Our analysis further shows that TPHC4 maintains lower inter-stream cosine similarity than mHC4 and mHC-TFA4, consistent with its goal of preserving stream diversity.
blocks.zh:
我们提出TPHC,它通过使用拉伸平行的子层分区来产生不同的回写组件来改进HC,而不增加注意和FFN子层的参数或FLOP.
TPHC实现了比mHC和mHC-TFA更低的培训和验证损失,为N { { 4, 8, 16 } N\in 4, 8, 16 },提高了mHC的平均零射常识推理精度,并且有8条流比mHC的成绩为16.
我们还实施TP,将TPHC4的培训时间管理费保持在8B规模,使TPHC16能够负担得起。
我们的分析进一步表明,TPHC4保持了低于mHC4和mHC-TFA4的下游间同位素相似性,符合其保护溪流多样性的目标.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Our pretraining experiments are limited to 1.1B-parameter models and 100B tokens, and thus do not cover larger models with more training data.
Our work focuses on dense Transformers, where TPHC builds its groups around tensor-parallel partitions.
Consequently, the current grouping and communication design cannot be directly transferred to MoE models with expert parallel.
We leave the extension of TPHC to MoE models for future work.
blocks.zh:
我们的预训实验仅限于1.1B参数模型和100B令牌,因此没有包含更多培训数据的更大的模型.
我们的工作重点是密集的变形器,TPHC在变形器-平行隔板周围建立了它的组.
因此,目前的分组和通信设计不能直接转让给与专家平行的教育部模型。
我们把TPHC的扩展留给教育部模式来做今后的工作。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work proposes an architectural modification for language-model pre-training and inherits the risks of the underlying models and training data. It does not introduce new data collection or new capabilities beyond those of standard LLMs. All models are trained on publicly released corpora, SlimPajama ( Soboleva et al., 2023 ) and, for the ablations, MiniPile ( Kaddour, 2023 ) , and inherit their biases. SlimPajama is released under the Apache 2.0 license and MiniPile under the MIT license of the Pile, both of which permit research use.
